metadata.description: The grovv stack marketplace — production-first project scaffolding for Claude Code. Install the grovv-stack plugin to scaffold a new or existing project end to end: product/development/technical specs, a development best-practices skills repository, a project-specific agent team (harness), issue tracking in GitHub Issues or Linear, cross-session memory, and the README.
